resolved_findings: Late geometry response compared against current image sequence as well as geometry sequence.
Conditional triangle hook compiles under Linux SDL2 plus n-gon renderer.
review.correction: Prior absent-type/TARGET_TWL claim was overbroad; actual rdTri integer member-access failure was Linux SDL2 plus RDCACHE_RENDER_NGONS.

limits: Experimental opaque vertex-colour triangles; no textures; sky/transparency/special rendering state approximate.
Native scene preparation, hidden graphics context and RGBA rendering remain active.
No performance, graphics-free startup, complete visual parity or every-browser certification.
Fresh live qualification covers stock JK1MP/m2 with two local bot clients; no new retail/JKWeb mixed-client, MotS, mod, map-transition or long-duration qualification.
Native backpressure/lease isolation is controlled-test evidence; sustained congested live gameplay is not measured.
disclosed_attempts: The first standard manager invocation exited zero but its output lacked a completion summary. A separate explicit TestResult run completed all176 tests successfully; no incomplete run is counted as a pass.
The first live launch used an incorrect bot binary path in the external QA config; correcting the harness path started the unchanged existing bot binary.
The early live geometry hash check included envelope headers; final evidence compares payload-only hashes and verifies paired native/image capture sequences.

native_ngon_compile.scope: Actual Linux SDL2 compile command plus RDCACHE_RENDER_NGONS, syntax-only; no full TWL build claim.

source_scope_note: Manager176 and gateway27 cover unchanged Python production code. Final Node34 and native19 plus n-gon syntax check cover the later JS/native guard wave. Historical source hash snapshots are retained without rewriting them.
